guard: a standing reader's sign-in source returns the person's bearer while their sign-in holds, and refuses with SignInChangedError once their row was granted again or the machine signed in as another account, naming which
why: A reader names its history consumer for the lifecycle it started on. Each mutation is a plausible one-line regression that lets it adopt a re-granted bearer, or hides the refusal from the caller that must stop. The suite imports the workspace source, so no build runs between the mutation and the suite.

mutations.name: the source adopts a bearer for another lifecycle
mutations.expectRed: a renewal after the row was granted again is refused as SignInChangedError

mutations.name: the refusal is a plain error a caller cannot recognize
mutations.find: return new SignInChangedError(`your sign-in ${started.owner}.${started.actor} was granted again
mutations.replace: return new Error(`your sign-in ${started.owner}.${started.actor} was granted again
mutations.expectRed: a renewal after the row was granted again is refused as SignInChangedError

mutations.name: another account on the same actor is taken for a re-grant
mutations.expectRed: a renewal for another account on the same actor and lifecycle is refused, naming that account
